6062.name: Saver Sub
6062.short: The tightest connection. The best protection.
desc: A one piece design eliminates a connection and adds durability.
Same OEM gauges as drill pipe for a better make-up and longer life.
Designed for Ditch Witch® drills and pipe increasing your reliability.
No adhesive or heat needed, reducing down time.

1070.name: Transition Sub
1070.short: Tough enough to take the stress
desc: Designed to absorb stress that would be transmitted to the drill pipe. • Manufactured to Ditch Witch® drill pipe tolerances, ensuring reliability. • High-strength steel and heat-treated to produce maximum durability. • Transition subs connect directly eliminating a collar connection.

1129.name: EZ Connect
desc: Designed to absorb stress that would otherwise be transmitted to the drill pipe.
EZ Connect assemblies offer a quick method of changing out tooling.
Absorbs the push and pull force, increasing the strength of the tool.
Uses the same gauges as Ditch Witch® drill pipe to extend the life of the tool.

6063.name: EZ Connect - Assembly
desc: Thread profile means connections can be made in as few as three rotations.
Patented thread compensates for normal wear allowing rotation to the next flat
Robust thread profile increases wear life and reduces the chance of cross-threading
Lubrication through the collar during pullback minimizes wear and extends tool life.

225.name: EZ Connect® (included in Assembly)
desc: Octagon design improves absorbed rotary force.
Small collar diameter decreases drag and improves productivity.
Dual, carbide-filled grooves on both ends reduce wear on the collar.
Standardized processes increase consistency and extend the life.

1413.name: EZ Connect
desc: Connections can be made in 12 rotations without machine torque.
Easy thread inspection allows for better quality control.
Manufactured to meet Ditch Witch® tolerances for increased reliability.
Connectors can be customized to adapt to your drilling specifications.
